# yanshi v1.0

Everyday AI development habits: shortest useful path, independent thinking shortcuts, contract-grounded evidence, and project-local lessons. This is an author-use build; real host sessions are not yet validated.

## Install

Requires Node >= 22.20 for the skills CLI.
Local, unpublished package (from its root):
npx skills add . --skill '*' -g -a codex -a claude-code
Published repository:
npx skills add Hackerismydream/yanshi --skill '*' -g -a codex -a claude-code

Remote installation uses the published revision, not a local ZIP.
Without Node, Python >= 3.10:
python3 scripts/setup.py install --host both
Only add --apply after reviewing the plan. Existing destinations cause refusal.

## Names

- yanshi: Use yanshi to move this forward; what should we do next?
- yanshi-think: Help me think this through before coding
- yanshi-build: Build this and check it when you are done
- yanshi-debug: Why is this failing? Help me debug it
- yanshi-check: Check this before I submit it; does it actually work?
- yanshi-handoff: Prepare a handoff for the next session
- yanshi-retro: Capture what went wrong and save the lesson in this project
- yanshi-first: Start from first principles, not the proposed solution
- yanshi-challenge: Challenge this plan; find a counterexample
- yanshi-trim: Cut the unnecessary complexity
- yanshi-ablate: Which of these changes actually helped?
- yanshi-boundary: Check the responsibility boundaries; do not split just to split

The entry chooses one current moment, not a pipeline. Each non-router skill stands alone. Five thinking shortcuts are manual-only in both hosts. Use $name in Codex and /name in Claude Code. Preserve project authorization; a read-only request does not authorize edits.

## Project memory

Each skill reads the target project's .yanshi/INDEX.md if present and only relevant active practices. No index does not trigger file creation. Retro saves only on a request to persist; missing evidence stays candidate, stale lessons become retired. Do not write into installed skills.

Opt-in new-session integration, from the target project root:
python3 /actual/package/path/scripts/setup.py project --project .
Preview first; --apply adds bounded blocks to the effective root Codex instruction file and CLAUDE.md. Do not overwrite existing instructions. New sessions must be tested for actual reads; file setup is not proof of model compliance.

## Validation

python3 scripts/check.py --self-test
Read verification.md for actual results and docs/codex-task.md for the local host task.
Read docs/author-practices.md for supported author statements; missing cases are not invented.

## Migration

Use CHANGELOG.md. Replace obsolete yanshi directories deliberately; do not clear unrelated skills or user project memory. Do not create a tag, push, or claim a release without authorization.

https://github.com/Hackerismydream/yanshi
